name: synthwave
label: Synthwave
vibe: CINEMATIC 80s retro futurism. Atmosphere and lighting do the work, never vector neon stickers. Smoked glass, volumetric haze, true black depth, film grain. Album-cover expensive, not party-flyer corny.

headline.treatment: tall condensed caps with horizontal scanline fade from violet to pale white

material.edgeGlow: soft magenta or cyan per component, restrained bloom, never a hard neon outline

motion.rest: subtle glow pulse + slow haze drift behind panels
motion.notes: Light-driven motion: blooms, sweeps, haze. Punchy springs with slight overshoot; the glow bloom leads each panel by ~6 frames (light arrives first). Cinematic, not sign-flicker.

atmosphere.fogLayer: volumetric haze lit violet, magenta, cyan with faint warm amber from one edge
atmosphere.gridFloor: subtle receding grid, catches light, never a glowing horizon graphic

componentAccents.textOnScreen: compact slim smoked glass pill, small white caps, single line, bottom-center
componentAccents.ctaBanner: slim smoked panel with soft magenta edge glow
componentAccents.subscribe: YouTube red button (functional color, overrides accent) + smoked glass bell chip with soft glow, cursor click animation
componentAccents.conceptSplitPanel: full-height smoked glass side panel with a soft glow edge, eyebrow dot label, smoked strike rows with cyan accents
componentAccents.concept75Field: void black field with volumetric haze and a faint grid floor, footage in a rounded portrait card with a soft glow edge, wide smoked rows
componentAccents.conceptFullScreen: smoked glass cards with restrained glow over the fullscreenBackground, scanline-fade title

fullscreenBackground: void black with volumetric fog lit violet, magenta and cyan, faint warm amber from one edge, subtle reflective grid floor, film grain (match the approved cinematic board)

styleAnchors.note: v1 flat neon-outline direction was REJECTED as corny. Match the cinematic board: fog, reflections, restrained glow, scanline type. The original approved reference was an 80s arcade album cover with volumetric fog and true black depth.
